summary: Tested the Smart Wallets feature (backend API + Doctor > SMART WALLETS UI) and two regression checks. Backend: 9/10 pytest pass. GET snapshot has every field; at test time learned_total was 296, graded_launches 105 and promoted 2-3. Manual add/remove works, an invalid address returns 400, all 13 config keys exist, mode soft/both is saved and stays after reload, and forgetting one learned wallet took learned_total from 296 to 295. One failure: smart_wallet_mode accepts any string. Frontend: the panel and every requested data-testid render. Mode buttons get the amber highlight and the choice survives a reload. Manual add shows the row and the 'wallet added' toast, then remove works. An invalid address shows an error toast. The learned table has 50 rows with W/M/rate/best/last-win and 3 TRIGGER badges. Bug found in the Knobs save flow (see ui_bugs). The GREYLIST sub-tab and the LIVE scanner/launch cards still render. All test changes were restored (mode both, max_per_hour 6, test wallet removed).

minor.issue: smart_wallet_mode is a plain str in models.py:560, so {smart_wallet_mode:'bogus'} returns 200 and is saved. At runtime mode() falls back to 'both', but GET /bot/config shows 'bogus' and the UI then highlights no mode button. Use Literal['hard','soft','both'].

Adding a wallet that is already learned upserts the same _id with kind=manual and overwrites the learned doc. A later remove_manual deletes the doc completely, so the learned history is lost from the DB (it stays in memory until restart, but _flush skips wallets that are in manual).

ui_bugs.issue: After Save, the input jumps back to the old value. Repro: set Fires/hour 6->5, Save, toast shows, API now has 5, but the input shows 6 again and still shows 6 after 6 s. Cause: Knobs gets no onConfigUpdate and calls setLocal({}) after api.updateConfig, so it falls back to the stale config prop. Side effect: typing the original value (6) no longer marks the form dirty, so the user cannot save it back without a page reload. Fix: pass onConfigUpdate to Knobs and call onConfigUpdate(updated) with the PUT response (as ModeRow already does).
The 'wipe learned' button (smart-wallets-forget-all) deletes ALL learned wallets in one click with no confirmation. It is a small grey link right next to the table. Add a confirm dialog.
The per-row forget (trash) button has no data-testid. Suggest smart-wallet-forget-<wallet>.

issues: The learned table shows all 50 rows inline with no pagination or collapse, so the knobs end up far below the fold. Consider a max-height scroll area or capping it at ~15 rows with 'show more'.
Section labels (text-neutral-600 at 9-10px) have low contrast on the near-black background.

action_items: Fix Knobs stale-value-after-save: pass onConfigUpdate into <Knobs> and call it with the PUT response
Validate smart_wallet_mode as Literal['hard','soft','both'] in BotConfig
Do not let add_manual overwrite and later delete an existing learned record (e.g. use a separate _id/collection, or keep the learned fields)
Add data-testid to the per-row learned forget button
critical_code_review_comments: Knobs: setLocal({}) after save with no parent config update means the UI is out of sync with the server (confirmed in the browser).
Knobs number inputs map an empty field to 0 (e.g. Fires/hour 0 = no cap, because `if cap and ...`). Clearing a field and saving disables the rate cap without warning.

Note for the main agent: GET /api/bot/config shows enabled=true and live_trading=true, and the UI shows BOT RUNNING · LIVE TRADING. Backend logs show POST /api/bot/start calls from external IPs. This was not caused by these tests, which only PUT smart_wallet_mode and smart_wallet_max_per_hour.

rca of the issue: Knobs revert: SmartWalletsPanel.jsx:220 renders <Knobs config={config}/> without onConfigUpdate. save() at line 63 calls api.updateConfig(local) and then setLocal({}), so val(k) falls back to the old config prop until the parent refetches config.
